tokens.name: surface-000
tokens.usage: App background behind every panel: desktop window, mobile screen, extension popup.

tokens.name: surface-100
tokens.usage: Panels: sidebar, item list, item detail, bottom sheets.

tokens.name: surface-200
tokens.usage: Raised areas inside a panel: field groups on the detail view, hovered list rows, secondary buttons.

tokens.name: surface-300
tokens.usage: Input fills, selected list row, pressed secondary button.

tokens.name: line
tokens.usage: Hairline dividers between panels and rows. Decorative only, never the sole boundary of a control.

tokens.name: line-strong
tokens.usage: Control borders (inputs, toggles off, checkboxes): 3:1 or more on surface-000, -100 and -200 in both themes.

tokens.name: ink
tokens.usage: Primary text and icons on every surface-* token.

tokens.name: ink-muted
tokens.usage: Secondary text: usernames under titles, field labels, timestamps. 4.5:1 on every surface-* token in both themes.

tokens.name: ink-faint
tokens.usage: Placeholders and disabled labels only. Not for information a person must read (3:1 on surface-100).

tokens.name: brass
tokens.usage: The Kandado colour: primary actions, the active vault, the logo. As text, on surface-000, surface-100 or brass-soft.

tokens.name: brass-strong
tokens.usage: Hover and pressed state of a brass fill.

tokens.name: brass-soft
tokens.usage: Tinted ground behind brass text: selected nav item, the active vault chip.

tokens.name: on-brass
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a brass fill (primary button label).

tokens.name: teal
tokens.usage: Secure and healthy states, the focus ring, links. As text, on surface-000, -100, -200 or teal-soft.

tokens.name: teal-soft
tokens.usage: Ground behind teal text: 'Strong' strength label, Monitor all-clear banner.

tokens.name: on-teal
tokens.usage: Text and icons on a teal fill.

tokens.name: coral
tokens.usage: Credit card items. As text, on the surfaces or coral-soft.

tokens.name: coral-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the card item icon.

tokens.name: sky
tokens.usage: Secure note items. As text, on the surfaces or sky-soft.

tokens.name: sky-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the note item icon.

tokens.name: plum
tokens.usage: Identity items. As text, on the surfaces or plum-soft.

tokens.name: plum-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the identity item icon.

tokens.name: moss
tokens.usage: Email alias items. As text, on the surfaces or moss-soft.

tokens.name: moss-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of the alias item icon.

tokens.name: danger
tokens.usage: Breached, weak, destructive. Always paired with an icon or word. As text, on the surfaces or danger-soft.

tokens.name: danger-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of breach banners and the 'Weak' label.

tokens.name: on-danger
tokens.usage: Text on a danger fill (Delete forever button).

tokens.name: warning
tokens.usage: Reused or old passwords, expiring cards. Always paired with an icon or word. As text, on the surfaces or warning-soft.

tokens.name: warning-soft
tokens.usage: Ground of 'Reused' and 'Fair' labels.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus: 2px solid ring, 2px offset. 3:1 or more on every surface in both themes.

tokens.name: link
tokens.usage: Inline links and website URLs on item detail.

tokens.name: kind-login
tokens.usage: Login items (username + password + website).

tokens.name: kind-alias
tokens.usage: Email alias items.

tokens.name: kind-card
tokens.usage: Credit card items.

tokens.name: kind-note
tokens.usage: Secure note items.

tokens.name: kind-identity
tokens.usage: Identity items.

tokens.name: kind-password
tokens.usage: Standalone generated passwords and passkeys.

tokens.name: scrim
tokens.usage: Overlay behind modals and bottom sheets.

styles.name: title-lg
styles.usage: Item title on the detail view; screen titles on mobile.

styles.name: body
styles.sample: Kandado locks after 5 minutes of inactivity.

styles.name: small
styles.usage: List row subtitles, helper text, extension popup body.

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Field labels above values on the detail view; uppercase.

styles.name: secret
styles.usage: Revealed passwords, card numbers, recovery codes. Mono so 0/O and l/1/I differ.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Icon-to-label gap inside small badges.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Gap between icon and text in buttons and rows.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: List row vertical padding; gap between fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Panel padding, row horizontal padding, mobile screen gutter.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Detail view padding; gap between field groups.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Section spacing on onboarding and settings.

tokens.name: space-7
tokens.usage: Top padding of unlock and empty states.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Badges, checkboxes, small icon buttons.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs, list rows, item icons.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: Field groups, cards, extension popup, dialogs.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom sheets (top corners).

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Vault chips, toggles, search bar.

tokens.name: shadow-pop
tokens.usage: Menus, autofill dropdown, toasts.

tokens.name: shadow-sheet
tokens.usage: Mobile bottom sheets.
